paper_id: Gong et al. - 2015 - Directional Diagnosis for Wireless Sensor Networks
title: Directional Diagnosis for Wireless Sensor Networks
motivation: 现有WSN诊断中信息收集与根因推断两阶段独立,导致要么信息冗余通信开销大,要么信息不足产生误判
problem_framing: 将诊断信息获取与故障推理过程解耦重组为迭代闭环,让推理结果指导后续探针选择
key_insight: diagnostic information acquirement is guided by the fault inference process
method_signature: DID方向性诊断:基于信念网络增量探测+节点追踪重建局部拓扑
evaluation_criteria: 故障检出率、误报率、诊断流量开销、拓扑恢复时间
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 若多个错误相互遮蔽,则无法被检测;信念网络构造复杂度高达O(V(V+E)),临时故障复制探针仅部分解决
evidence_for_taste: diagnosis information acquirement is guided by the fault inference process
either redundant information...or incomplete information for root-cause inference
the masked errors are unable to be detected in all online diagnosis models
the higher of threshold value, the lower of detection ratio and false positive ratio
the complete solution for this is the main interest of our future research
thinking_moves: 把诊断的信息收集与根因推断两独立阶段合并为迭代反馈循环
用信念网络编码网络元素间因果依赖,支持概率推断
承认遮蔽错误(masked errors)检测的固有限制
承认信念网络时空复杂度高的工程约束
迭代细化推理结果直到候选故障集置信度达标
